digest.overview: Quiet window dominated by OpenAI executive churn, Google's Gemini hitting 1B monthly users, and a $1.1B seed into xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin's new personal-agents startup River AI. Anthropic's unreleased model notched incremental progress on the Riemann hypothesis; Google AMIE showed real-time video consults.

top_story.headline: Gemini app hits 1B monthly users
top_story.summary: Google's Gemini reaches 1B MAUs, matching ChatGPT's June milestone and becoming Google's 14th product at that scale and its fastest-growing ever.
top_story.why_it_matters: Signals sustained consumer traction for Google's frontier model amid OpenAI's internal moves; Demis Hassabis called it their 'fastest growing product ever.'

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Celebration of Gemini scale and AMIE clinical results offset by OpenAI exec exits and skepticism around closed-model watermarking; community mood pragmatic rather than euphoric.

frontier_labs.headline: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI's longtime COO and special projects lead, departs after 8 years
frontier_labs.summary: Lightcap announced exit in internal memo; Sam Altman publicly thanked him for taking on 'any function and challenge.'

frontier_labs.headline: General Catalyst leads $1.1B into 2-month-old River AI
frontier_labs.summary: Founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, the personal-agents startup raised $1.1B at inception.

frontier_labs.headline: Unreleased Anthropic model advances Riemann hypothesis
frontier_labs.summary: Model made measurable progress on the 150-year-old unsolved math problem; Anthropic has not released details or weights.

influencer_takes.author: Demis Hassabis
influencer_takes.quote: 1B for the @GeminiApp ! Our fastest growing product ever 🚀
influencer_takes.context: Direct celebration of the user milestone from DeepMind/Google DeepMind leadership

influencer_takes.author: Sam Altman
influencer_takes.quote: thank you for everything! ... we would not be where we are without you. excited to work together on what's next.
influencer_takes.context: Public farewell to departing OpenAI COO Brad Lightcap

influencer_takes.author: roon
influencer_takes.quote: sam altman hires founders and cages them for years
influencer_takes.context: Skeptical take on OpenAI retention amid Lightcap exit

research_radar.headline: AMIE demonstrates real-time clinical video consultations
research_radar.summary: Google's research medical AI system shows first-of-its-kind real-time video consult capabilities in new study.

post_ideas.hook: Gemini quietly matched ChatGPT's 1B-user mark while OpenAI lost another veteran exec
post_ideas.draft: Gemini hit 1B MAUs the same month OpenAI's 8-year COO walked. Scale is table stakes now; retention and agent startups are the real race.
post_ideas.why_viral: Contrasts two frontier labs' trajectories with concrete numbers and timely exec news

post_ideas.hook: xAI co-founder raises $1.1B for personal agents before most people know the company exists
post_ideas.draft: River AI, founded two months ago by xAI's Igor Babuschkin, just closed $1.1B. Personal agents are apparently the new frontier after chat.
post_ideas.why_viral: Eye-popping valuation + founder pedigree creates surprise and FOMO

post_ideas.hook: Anthropic's unreleased model moved the needle on a 150-year math problem
post_ideas.draft: Riemann hypothesis still unsolved, but an unreleased Anthropic model reportedly made non-trivial progress. Closed labs keep the interesting stuff inside.
post_ideas.why_viral: Math milestone + secrecy tension; contrarian to open-weights hype
